title: Do You Have My Size In Stock? Assortment and Inventory Optimization Under the Consider-Fit-Then-Choose Choice Model
summary: In apparel retail and other applications, when a customer's preferred size is unavailable, demand may shift to nearby sizes. This substitution creates new assortment and inventory optimization challenges by coupling product availability and demand across sizes. We introduce the consider-fit-then-choose (CFTC) model to capture such size-dependent choice behavior. Products may be offered in multiple sizes, which affect customer preferences and consideration sets through fit, measured by distance from the customer's ideal size.
